csv_project_name: CMAR for Polk New Kathleen Government Center Construction
csv_scope_of_work: A new Kathleen government facility include a 75,000 squarefoot building with walking trails, green space, a playground and other community spaces on a 27-acre site. A separate RFP will be issued for Architectural and Engineering services. Construction Manager at Risk (CMAR) to handle site development and construction. The County may award one or more projects to a single CMAR. Because the County utilizes both CMAR and competitive lump-sum bidding, the selected A/E firm must coordinate with the eventual CMAR firm. This coordination includes preconstruction, bidding, and construction services. Proposers must demonstrate a working knowledge of both CMAR and competitive lump-sum bidding delivery methods. The intent of this Request for Proposal (RFP) is to select an experienced Contractor to provide Construction Management at Risk (CMAR) services for the preconstruction, including the preparation and submission of a guaranteed maximum price (GMP), and construction phase services for a new 70,000 square foot facility. It is the intent of the County to select and negotiate a CMAR agreement with one CMAR company as the prime contractor. The County will negotiate a fee schedule for the selected CMAR Company once an RFP selection committee recommendation has been approved by the Board of County Commissioners
